The reviews in `/work/context.txt` have no labels, so I judged each one's sentiment myself. I did this by reading the 16 July reviews, not by running a classifier.

One, "Host For clashofclan", is too short for me to judge. Even if both mixed reviews and the unclear one count as negative, positive still wins by a wide margin.

content.text: Clearly mostly positive.

The answer is **Label: positive**, and I wrote it to `/work/answer.txt`.

The reviews in `/work/context.txt` have no labels, so I judged each one's sentiment myself. I did this by reading the 16 July reviews, not by running a classifier.

By my reading, 13 are clearly positive. Examples are "Awesome app", "Best emulator ever" and "Excellent". Two are mixed, "I miss you!" and "Dorost kaar nemikone", and lean negative. One, "Host For clashofclan", is too short for me to judge. Even if both mixed reviews and the unclear one count as negative, positive still wins by a wide margin.
